offering_description.value: Designs and sells IoT connectivity hardware, including cellular routers, console servers, embedded modules and single-board computers, plus related software and cloud management. Customers are businesses, OEMs and public-sector bodies that connect and manage remote devices and networks. Products are designed in-house and built by contract manufacturers.

primary_products.value: cellular routers and gateways; console servers; embedded system-on-modules; single-board computers; RF and device connectivity modules

primary_services.value: remote device management cloud services; connectivity subscriptions; custom engineering and design services; technical support

customer_segment.value: B2B: OEMs, enterprises, retailers, utilities, transportation and industrial firms, IT network operators; B2G: public safety agencies, municipalities and government agencies

end_markets.value: industrial automation; smart cities and public safety; transportation; retail; energy and utilities; medical

revenue_model.value: product sales: hardware routers, modules and computers sold through channels and to OEMs; subscription: recurring SaaS for device management, warranty and support plans; service fees: custom design and engineering services

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: designs connectivity hardware, built via contract manufacturers, sold to businesses and OEMs; software / platform: cloud-based remote management and monitoring software for connected devices

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific and other regions, headquartered in Minnesota

specialization.value: related lines: routers, console servers, embedded modules, and management software and services for IoT connectivity

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: technology distributors and value-added resellers; direct sales: OEM and large enterprise accounts; partners / resellers: system integrators and carrier partners; online: web store and online resellers
distribution_channels.category: distributors / dealers; direct sales; partners / resellers; online

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Wireless device certifications (FCC, CE), product safety, cybersecurity and environmental rules such as RoHS
